preview.prebuildCommand: npx expo prebuild --clean && mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/drawable && cp assets/splash.png android/app/src/main/res/drawable/splashscreen_logo.png && for d in mdpi hdpi xhdpi xxhdpi xxxhdpi; do mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/drawable-$d && cp assets/splash.png android/app/src/main/res/drawable-$d/splashscreen_logo.png; done
